svg.title: Agent harness benchmark (illustration)
svg.desc: Illustration with synthetic data. A dark isometric platform floats above a blue glow. From a shaft in its centre rises Tentaflake as a giant crystal kraken: a faceted head with two narrow glowing eyes, a beard of tentacles, and the Tentaflake mark as its crown inside a faint halo. Its arms are the harness. Eight of them dock from above on eight dark, armoured agents, one holds the evaluator's amber eye aloft, and larger ones reach around the platform from below. Each agent stands on its own pad beside a hologram of its isolated Linux network with a client, a router, a firewall and the services web and admin. The eye probes each network in turn; lamps show whether web is reachable and admin is blocked. The task is 'repair routing and firewall'. The outcomes are invented for the picture.
svg.text: holds every agent and the eye
